title: Early Evidence (ca. 12,000 BP) for Iron Oxide Mining on the Pacific Coast of South America
lineage: Brief paraphrased research notes, not a source copy.

passages.note: The authors describe iron-oxide workings and 491 hammerstones recovered from early Holocene levels. Unit 1 layer 7 charcoal sample UGAMS 5442 has a listed calibrated range of 8717–8472 BCE; it dates associated context rather than each tool or mine origin.
